stemMarkdown: The price of an article is first increased by 11%, and then the new price is decreased by 18%. What is the net percentage change in price? (Enter a negative value if it is a net decrease.)
solutionMarkdown: Take the original price as 100. After a 11% increase: $100 \times (1 + 11/100) = 111.00$. After a 18% decrease on 111.00: $111.00 \times (1 - 18/100) = 91.02$. Net change $= 91.02 - 100 = -8.98\%$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Shortcut formula: net \% change $= p_1 - p_2 - \dfrac{p_1 p_2}{100} = 11 - 18 - \dfrac{198}{100} = -8.98\%$.
